name: brightsec
description: Official Bright Security skills for coding agents. Dynamic application and API security testing (DAST) powered by the Bright engine, MCP server, and CLI.

plugins.name: bright-scan
plugins.description: Run the Bright DAST loop inside your coding agent: discover entrypoints, run a scan against the running app/API, parse vulnerabilities, and turn them into prioritized fix tasks — then rescan to verify. Uses the Bright MCP server (runDiscovery, runScan, listScanVulnerabilities) or the Bright CLI.

plugins.name: bright-api
plugins.description: Query the Bright platform for security posture reporting, vulnerability analysis, scan history, and project/entrypoint management. Read-only reporting across all your projects.

plugins.name: bright-auth
plugins.description: Create, test, and debug Bright authentication objects so scans can reach protected endpoints. Covers bearer/header, form login, OAuth/OIDC, and multi-step flows via addAuth/testAuth.

plugins.name: bright-ci
plugins.description: Wire Bright DAST into your CI/CD pipeline. Provider-agnostic: detects GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure Pipelines, and more, edits the pipeline file in place with a Bright CLI scan job, and prompts for BRIGHT_TOKEN storage.

plugins.name: bright-lab
plugins.description: Scaffold intentionally vulnerable, ultra-minimalist test apps as isolated DAST targets (labs). Themed, Docker-packaged, with a documented vulnerability inventory for validating Bright scans.

plugins.name: bright
plugins.description: Bright umbrella — one-command install of the default skill set (bright-scan, bright-api, bright-auth, bright-ci).
